verdict.rationale: CoreWeave docs confirm billing insights showing billable resource usage/consumption breakdowns by resource type, and explicitly state usage can be exported programmatically via the FOCP API (coreweave-docs-34, coreweave-docs-13). However, there is no explicit documentation of tagging or breakdowns by team/workload/project attribution, only by resource type. Missing for 10: explicit team/workload/cost-center tagging or attribution fields in the billing API, and independent confirmation of the FOCUS API's granularity in practice.
